Status turns passing only when every listed test passes on the CI path. Never weaken or delete an entry except through an approved infeasibility decision record.
fixture_note: Every CI path builds its own fixture with cargo xtask fixture, which runs examples/build-fixture and writes OUT/.planroom/config.toml loading examples/packs/ruby, because TRUTH.json lists the healthcheck container and its edges (DR-13). S10 uses --no-packs. It also records OUT as a trusted workspace in a temporary data root (PLANROOM_DATA), so each run's ledger, backups, trust records and hand-off clones start empty (DR-48, DR-53), and strict replay counts as consent to every provider (DR-49). The Ruby pack is out of tree, but the fixture's config adds it, so it loads with no card (DR-60). Strict replay also counts as a configured Jev backend, so no Jev setup card is dealt (DR-50).
